nodes.name: Request allocation
nodes.notes: Custom meta-learner (online / bandit allocation over strategy sleeves).

assignments.name: text
assignments.value: ={{ "[ALLOCATION] v" + $json.r.version_id + " applied automatically (within bounds): " + $("Decide path").first().json.deltas.filter(d => Math.abs(d.delta) > 1e-9).map(d => d.strategy + " " + (d.delta * 100).toFixed(1) + "pp").join(", ") }}

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ weights: $('Decide path').first().json.proposed_weights, token: $('Approval token').first().json.token, proposed_by: 'meta_learner', rationale: $('Decide path').first().json.rationale, ttl_s: 14400 }) }}

assignments.name: text
assignments.value: ={{ "[ALLOCATION] v" + $("Approval result").first().json.version_id + ": " + ($json.r.approved ? "approved by " + $("Approval result").first().json.approver + " and applied" : "not applied (" + $json.r.reason + ")") }}
